answer.reason: In the EIA Ohio Electricity Profile 2024 Table 1, the net generation attributed to IPP & CHP is 15,750,379 megawatthours. The larger figure (126,996,327 megawatthours) represents total net generation for Ohio, not the IPP & CHP category.

metadata.prompt:

A. 15,750,379 megawatthours
B. 126,996,327 megawatthours

Source citation: Ohio Electricity Profile 2024 (https://www.eia.gov/electricity/state/ohio/index.php)

Supplied draft answer: A
